nodes.description: mapping(address=>bool) private _enable: whitelist controlling whether an address may send tokens to the _uni address
address private _uni: destination address that triggers the whitelist check in _beforeTokenTransfer
address private _owner in Ownable: privileged account used by the onlyOwner modifier
mapping(address=>uint256) private _balances: token balances mutated by _transfer/_mint/_burn
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) private _allowances: spender allowances written by _approve
uint256 private _totalSupply: total minted supply checked against the 1e12*1e18 cap
DONKEYKONG constructor: mints 1,000,000,000,000e18 to 0x1ec7...f493 and whitelists that address
DONKEYKONG.transfer(address user, bool enable) public onlyOwner: writes arbitrary whitelist flags into _enable
DONKEYKONG.RenounceOwnership(address uni_) public onlyOwner: sets the _uni gating address
DONKEYKONG._beforeTokenTransfer hook: rejects transfers whose destination is _uni unless the sender is whitelisted
DONKEYKONG._mint override: enforces the supply cap then calls ERC20._mint
Ownable.onlyOwner modifier: gates owner-restricted functions
Ownable.owner() accessor returning _owner
ERC20._transfer: validates addresses, runs the _beforeTokenTransfer hook and updates balances
ERC20._approve: validates addresses and stores the allowance in _allowances
ERC20.transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public: delegates to _transfer(_msgSender(), recipient, amount)
msg.sender reached through Context._msgSender(), used for the owner check and as transfer originator
require(_enable[from], "something went wrong") in _beforeTokenTransfer: owner-controlled mapping decides whether a user can transfer to _uni
require(ERC20.totalSupply() + amount <= 1000000000000 * 10**18) in the _mint override: supply-cap arithmetic check
_balances[recipient] += amount in ERC20._transfer: balance arithmetic on the recipient side
_balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount in ERC20._transfer: balance subtraction after the senderBalance >= amount require
require(owner() == _msgSender()) inside the onlyOwner modifier: the single access-control gate of the contract
address user: account whose whitelist flag is written by transfer(address,bool)
bool enable: whitelist value written for user by transfer(address,bool)
address uni_: new gating destination stored into _uni
address from in _beforeTokenTransfer: key looked up in the _enable whitelist
address to in _beforeTokenTransfer: compared with _uni to activate the whitelist check
uint256 amount in _beforeTokenTransfer: transferred amount passed to the hook
address account in the _mint override: mint recipient
uint256 amount in the _mint override: amount added to supply and balances
address sender in ERC20._transfer: source of the internal transfer
address recipient in ERC20._transfer: destination of the internal transfer
uint256 amount in ERC20._transfer: moved token quantity
address recipient in ERC20.transfer(address,uint256): public transfer destination
uint256 amount in ERC20.transfer(address,uint256): public transfer quantity
uint256 senderBalance in ERC20._transfer: cached _balances[sender] used for the subtraction

edges.reason: The onlyOwner modifier executes the owner equality require before the guarded function body
The owner check consumes msg.sender through Context._msgSender()
The owner check reads the owner() accessor to compare against the caller
owner() returns the _owner state variable
DONKEYKONG.transfer(address,bool) is restricted by onlyOwner
DONKEYKONG.RenounceOwnership(address) is restricted by onlyOwner
transfer(address,bool) writes an arbitrary account into the _enable whitelist mapping
RenounceOwnership stores uni_ into _uni, the address that triggers transfer gating
user parameter selects the whitelist key written by transfer(address,bool)
enable parameter sets the whitelist boolean written by transfer(address,bool)
uni_ parameter becomes the stored _uni gating address
The whitelist require reads the owner-controlled _enable mapping
from parameter is the key looked up in _enable inside the require
to parameter is compared with _uni to decide whether the whitelist check applies
_uni is the destination address that activates the whitelist branch
A failed whitelist require reverts the whole _beforeTokenTransfer hook
ERC20._transfer invokes the virtual _beforeTokenTransfer hook before balances are updated, letting an override observe or mutate state pre-transfer
Public ERC20.transfer delegates to the internal _transfer
The constructor mints the initial supply through the overridden _mint
The overridden _mint performs the cap require before minting
The cap check reads _totalSupply through ERC20.totalSupply()
account parameter is the mint recipient in the _mint override
amount parameter is added to the supply and balances inside the _mint override
amount parameter feeds the totalSupply() + amount cap comparison
_mint increases _balances[account] through super._mint
_mint increases _totalSupply through super._mint
sender parameter is the debit side of ERC20._transfer
recipient parameter is the credit side of ERC20._transfer
amount parameter is the moved quantity processed by ERC20._transfer
_balances[sender] is read into the senderBalance local
senderBalance local is the left operand of the balance subtraction
The decremented value is written back into _balances[sender]
The incremented value is written into _balances[recipient]
ERC20._transfer executes the recipient balance increment
ERC20._transfer executes the sender balance decrement after the balance require
ERC20._approve writes the allowance into _allowances
recipient parameter of the public transfer is forwarded to _transfer
amount parameter of the public transfer is forwarded to _transfer

normalization_plan.reason: The user parameter only exists to key the _enable write performed by DONKEYKONG.transfer(address,bool)
The enable parameter only exists to provide the boolean written into _enable by DONKEYKONG.transfer(address,bool)
uni_ only flows into the _uni state variable written by RenounceOwnership
from is only used as the lookup key in the require(_enable[from]) unsafe operation
to is only used in the _beforeTokenTransfer comparison against _uni
amount in the hook is only forwarded through _beforeTokenTransfer and is unused by the gating logic
account is only the mint recipient handled by the _mint override
amount in the _mint override is the operand of the cap require unsafe operation
sender is only the debit account processed inside ERC20._transfer
recipient is only the credit account processed inside ERC20._transfer
amount is only the moved quantity processed inside ERC20._transfer
recipient is only forwarded from the public transfer into _transfer
amount is only forwarded from the public transfer into _transfer
senderBalance is a temporary cache of _balances[sender] used solely by the balance subtraction unsafe operation
